title: A deep dive is a decision, not a lecture
caption: Name the problem, compare a few options against the requirements, commit to one and say why.

steps.text: Pick the part with the most risk, or ask: "I'd like to go deep on ranking and the write path. Any preference?"
One sentence of problem: "rank of one player among 5 M, under 100 ms".
Two or three real options, each with a pro and a con.
Test each against the requirements. Say out loud why an option loses: that is the trade-off talk interviewers listen for.
Commit: "sorted set, because reads need O(log n) rank and a few seconds of lag is allowed". A dive without a choice doesn't count.
